retrievalProfile.description: A gritty, high-contrast urban portrait featuring a central figure against a desaturated city backdrop with bold, layered metallic and script typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A central male figure in streetwear stands in front of a desaturated, high-contrast urban tenement building. The composition is layered with a row of skulls at the mid-ground, bold metallic-textured display text, and secondary script lettering. The overall tone is gritty and industrial, emphasizing street culture through jewelry, accessories, and a muted color palette.
coreVisualRelationships: Central figure dominates the foreground against a receding urban perspective
High-contrast desaturated background emphasizes the subject's skin tones and clothing
Metallic display typography overlaps the subject to create depth
Repetitive skull motifs act as a horizontal divider between the subject and the background
coreInvariants: High-contrast lighting on the central subject
Layered typography with varying styles (metallic, script, distressed)

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central medium-full shot of a male figure, occupying approximately 60% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the large metallic display text across the center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the subject's face down to the central typography, then outward to the background details and lower script text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is densely packed with architectural details, skulls, and text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Desaturated greys and blacks in the background and clothing.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm skin tones and gold/silver metallic accents in the jewelry and text.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Subtle red and blue highlights within central graphic emblems.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation in the environment vs. higher saturation and contrast on the subject and typography.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid vibrant primary colors except in small graphic details

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy slab serifs and elegant copperplate scripts
letterConstructionRules: Display text features heavy 3D beveling and metallic textures
Secondary text uses high-contrast fluid script with long flourishes
Tertiary text uses distressed, stencil-like block capitals
characterSpecificRedesigns: Gold or silver outer glows on main display characters
Heavy drop shadows to separate text from the busy background
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Bold industrial slab serifs paired with elegant, traditional script for a 'rough vs. refined' contrast.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the heavy slab-serif foundation for the display text.
Matches the high-contrast, flourished secondary lettering.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast, desaturated urban street scene with a tenement building. Place a row of semi-transparent skulls across the middle horizontal axis. Position a central male figure in streetwear with visible jewelry.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply large, beveled metallic slab-serif text across the center. Add a secondary script title with white fill and black shadows in the lower-left, angled slightly upward.

verificationChecks: Is the background desaturated compared to the subject?
Does the display text have a 3D metallic texture?
Are the skull motifs visible but integrated into the mid-ground?
Is the script text legible against the subject's clothing?

postGenerationChecks: Check for 3D depth in the main title
Ensure the background doesn't overpower the central figure
Verify the script text has elegant flourishes
Confirm the presence of urban/street elements like jewelry or brickwork
recipe.reuseFormula: Urban Portrait + Desaturated Cityscape + [Metallic Slab Serif] + [Elegant Script] + Gritty Texture Overlays
